english.title: Failure of operating licence holder to notify Commission of conviction of personal licence holder - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a relevant operating licence, failed without reasonable excuse to notify the Gambling Commission as soon as was reasonably practicable after becoming aware of the conviction of the holder of a personal licence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PERSONAL LICENCE HOLDER..), for a relevant offence and the sentence passed in respect of that offence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 138 of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes: Section 138(1)of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that this offence applies irrespective of the conviction being inside or outside Great Britain.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the holder of a relevant operating licence failed without reasonable excuse to notify the Gambling Commission as soon as reasonably practicable after becoming aware of the conviction of the holder of a personal licence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PERSONAL LICENCE HOLDER..), for a relevant offence and the sentence passed in respect of that offence.
